params.name: start_date
params.description: The start date in UTC (in the format YYYY-MM-DD) you want to query transactions for. Defaults to start_date of consent transaction range.

params.name: async
params.description: When true the API will return a results_id which can be fetched from the /data/v2/results endpoint when ready. Note: it''s recommended to use the sync flow (async=false) for all requests by adapting the data workflow for connected entities.

items.docs:
The Freelancer Cashflow Insights API provides access to freelancers' certified income data.
It offers insights into total and monthly cash inflows (filtered based on income verification logic) and outflows.
